boardQuestion: Where does executive AI demand outrun the team’s ability to convert policy decisions into shipped operator controls?
currentPosture: The lane is commercially strong, but governance packets still wait on too many reviewers before they ship.
frictionNarrative: AI governance is high-value, but decision latency is the main tax on scaling it cleanly.
operatingReality: Board-facing policy work is solid, though too many decisions still queue behind a small set of approvers.
riskHeadline: Executive demand is outpacing approval capacity and creating avoidable delay.
frictionSignal: Review cycles bunch up around the same policy, trust, and legal checkpoints.

headline: AI governance is strong commercially, but still slowed by decision drag.
